stem: A new TV ad doubled CTR from 1.0% to 2.0%. Over the same weeks, the orders credited to the ad stayed flat and the spend rose. What is the best reading?

options.text: The extra clicks did not turn into orders, so each order now costs more
The ad works twice as well, since twice as many showings now end in a click
The ad reaches twice as many people, since CTR counts the people who saw it
The spend figure must be wrong, since a higher CTR always lowers the spend
